_note: The waiver ledger read by scripts/security/scan-gate.mjs (--waivers).
A waiver releases ONE advisory from the CVSS>=7.0 block, and only until it expires.
Policy: a waiver may be granted for at most 90 days, or 30 days when the advisory is
Critical. `expires` is inclusive. An expired, malformed, too-long or future-dated
waiver is refused and the advisory blocks again — so an entry here is never silent.
{ "id": "GHSA-...." (or a CVE, matched against the advisory's aliases),
"package": "optional scoping; omit to cover the advisory in every package",
"reason": "why this is acceptable — at least 8 characters",
Every entry is expected to carry a link to the issue that will remove it.
